cm.keys: Keys: Tab moves from row to row · Enter opens the row’s act · Esc closes a menu.

balance.title: Balance
balance.info: Balance: the figures of this customer with this company, in two directions — what it owes us, and what we hold or owe it. They are never netted and never added across currencies. Each figure opens its section. “What needs you” lists what waits for a person, each with its one door.
balance.calm: Nothing needs you: nothing is late, nothing waits.
balance.calmNew: Nothing needs you: {customer} has no order yet.

needs.depositLate_other: {count} deposits are late, the oldest since {date}: {order}
needs.invoicesLate_other: {count} invoices are late, the oldest by {days}
needs.invoicesLateSome: Invoices are late, the oldest by {days}
needs.onHoldSince: On hold since {date} ({reason}): new orders and shipments wait
needs.onHold: On hold ({reason}): new orders and shipments wait
needs.onAccount: {amount} on account is placed on nothing: place it or give it back
needs.onAccountWords: Money on account is placed on nothing: place it or give it back

needs.notes_other: {count} credit notes have money left to refund

needs.shippedBy_other: {count} shipments are not invoiced yet (invoice by {date})

collect.title: To collect
collect.info: To collect: every deposit and before-shipping payment that is asked and still open, and every open invoice — oldest due first. A deposit’s act opens the ORDER’s own window here. An invoice’s act opens Finance’s. Steps that are not asked yet are on each order’s Money tab.
collect.reading: Reading the open requests and invoices…
collect.reminderWaits: Reminder level {level} waits for a yes
collect.notEuro: Not in euro: its payment is recorded outside the app for now
collect.euroOnly: Payments are recorded in euro only today: this invoice is in {currency}.
collect.foot: What each order has paid and still owes, also what is not asked yet:

none.title: Nothing here yet
none.collect: Nothing to collect: no deposit is asked and no invoice is open.
none.invoices: No document yet: invoices appear here when goods ship or a deposit is paid.
none.received: No payment received yet, and nothing to give back.

invoices.info: Invoices & credit notes: every document of this customer, where it stands and what is still to pay. Each ⋯ opens Finance’s own window. An issued invoice never changes: a credit note corrects it.

note.noTab: Money needs the right to see prices, receivables or credit: this is the Work tab, which your role may open.

received.title: Payments & refunds
received.reading: Reading the payments and the refunds…
received.info: Payments & refunds: what came in and where it was placed, and what goes back. Money placed on nothing is the customer’s money on account: place it on an invoice, or give it back. Finance calls this money the customer’s credit balance. To give back: refunds to make, and credit notes that give back money already paid. No bank is called: the office pays in its bank and marks the refund made here.
received.onAccountTitle: On account — paid, placed on nothing
received.from: From the payment of {date} · waits {days}. Reminders are held while it is not placed.
received.held: Reminders are held while it is not placed.
received.madeHint: kept with the value date and the bank’s reference
received.madeNone: No refund made, cancelled or voided yet.
received.returns_one: Credit value of its returns in {year}: {amount} on {count} return
received.returns_other: Credit value of its returns in {year}: {amount} on {count} returns

credit.title: Credit & terms
credit.reading: Reading the credit and the terms…
credit.info: Credit & terms: may it order on credit, and how it pays. Used = open invoices + orders not invoiced yet. Over the limit or on hold, a new order waits for a yes and a shipment is held. The terms are changed on Terms & requirements.
credit.usedIs: used = open invoices + orders not invoiced yet

chase.title: Statement & reminders
chase.info: Statement & reminders: the statement of account, the reminders of this customer and the stops in force (a promise to pay, a dispute). A stop holds the reminders of ONE invoice until its day or until it is lifted. A stop is added from the invoice’s row in To collect. The talk itself is in the thread beside the tab.
chase.waits: Waits for a person: approve and send, edit or skip

price.reading: Reading the orders whose prices differ…
price.info: Price check: the orders whose price differs from the customer’s own price (its PO, its portal, or typed by us). A price is typed, changed or the difference accepted on the order.
price.missing_one: {count} order has no customer price yet ›
price.missing_other: {count} orders have no customer price yet ›
price.foot: A price is typed, changed or accepted on the order.

margin.title: Margin & cost
margin.info: Margin & cost: what this customer’s orders are worth and what they cost us — materials used, work, subcontract work. Now = the estimate. Read when you reach the section.
margin.honest: What its orders cost us: materials used, work, and subcontract work. A supplier’s invoice is on the ORDER’s Margin › Documents — never a supplier’s total here.
margin.twoCurrencies: Its orders are in two currencies: no one figure is honest.
